name: Geometry Processing via Field Derivatives
definition: A method for geometry processing tasks (smoothing, sharpening, rigid deformations like twists and bends) that approximates a local surface of a level set by utilizing the derivatives of the underlying field. It relies solely on field derivatives to use intrinsic geometric properties like curvatures, enabling loss functions that capture surface priors like elasticity or rigidity. It exploits the inherent infinite differentiability of specific neural fields to facilitate optimization of loss functions involving higher-order derivatives through gradient descent.
